day_shape: 39 items dominated by Strait of Hormuz incident cluster — UKMTO drone-strike report on tanker, oil slick off Qeshm/Sirri, reduced shipping traffic — plus IRGC claims of MQ-9 and F-15 intercepts; nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz maritime incident
threads.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker in the outbound lane of the Strait of Hormuz was targeted by a drone strike, and satellite imagery showed oil slicks off Qeshm and Sirri islands. Jerusalem Post reported shipping traffic fell below monthly average; Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson Bagheri said users of the strait bear legal and moral obligations to remedy environmental damage.

threads.label: IRGC air-defence intercept claims
threads.summary: IRGC Public Relations claimed an MQ-9 drone was intercepted and destroyed over Hormozgan Province by a new air defence system, with Defa Press publishing images it said showed destroyed American drones and fighters. A follow-up IRIB report claimed details on how an F-15 was downed and referenced Ukrainian-made drones guided via Starlink.

threads.label: Araghchi–Greece call and Europe rebuke
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press reported Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi told Greek counterpart Yorgos Gerapetritis by phone that the European Union lacks moral standing to preach on human rights, rejecting EU statements on Iran. Iran International separately reported a state-TV caption error rendered Araghchi as "minister of the Kharijites."

threads.label: Lebanon and Hezbollah developments
threads.summary: Defa Press reported continued Israeli demolition operations in southern Lebanese villages including Al-Mansoura, and cited Lebanese Speaker Nabih Berri calling for Israel to be forced to halt aggression. Defa Press also announced Hezbollah Secretary-General Sheikh Naim Qassem would address regional developments at 6:30pm Beirut time.

threads.label: Resistance commemoration and martyr messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB carried Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibabadi marking 23 Mordad as Day of Islamic Resistance, and Ayatollah Ahmad Khatami announcing fortieth-day funeral ceremonies for the "martyred leader" in Tehran, Qom and Mashhad. Additional items included Ayatollah Khatami's claim Iran's missile capability will "humiliate America" and repeated imagery of Qasem Soleimani.
